name: tool_ends_call
about: A tool whose effect ends the conversation ends the call only when it succeeds. A result that reports an error leaves the call going, and the model answers it. Once the tool succeeds, the call ends with no model reply after it: the goodbye rides in the reply that called the tool.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

model.text: Sorry, I could not end the call. Anything else?

spoken: Sorry, I could not end the call. Anything else?
